A session lasts 30 days because `createSessionToken` in `src/server/services/session-service.ts` sets `expiresAt` from `SESSION_TTL_DAYS` when the cookie is issued at sign-in. On a later request, `getSessionPrincipal` in `src/lib/session.ts` treats the session as gone once `expiresAt` is no longer after the current time, and the dashboard layout then redirects to the sign-in screen.

ANSWER: src/server/services/session-service.ts, src/lib/session.ts
